messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Staffing & scenario commitments — annual planning sync

Hi team,

We need to lock down target bands and the staffing commitment signal for the FY27 planning window. This thread is the kickoff for three deliverables we need by the dates below: 

- Scenario templates (base / downside / upside) with top-line revenue and headcount delta — due: 11/10
- Team-level staffing asks mapped to OKRs (owner + rationale) — due: 11/12
- QBR deck outlines for exec review (one slide per critical risk/assumption) — due: 11/17

Quick asks: please confirm owners for each deliverable, and add any cross-functional owners (CS, Product, Eng) inline. I've attached a template to keep formats consistent.

Notes / framing:
- We want to bias toward simplicity: three scenarios with clear probability markers, and a recommended "go/no-go" staffing delta per org.
- Markus: please provide the reserve buffer guidance and any constraints for capitalized hiring.
- Mina: finance model inputs (revenue sensitivity & comp assumptions).
- Stephanie: add downstream cost lines for Ops (SaaS infra) and any likely SLA-related spend.

I'll run a short sync on Wed 11/04 (30 minutes) to triage any blockers and confirm owners — calendar invite incoming.

Attachments: annual_planning_template_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Staffing & scenario commitments — annual planning sync

Marissa — thanks for kicking this off. Confirming owners:
- Scenario templates: Laura (will partner with Mina on the revenue sheets)
- Staffing asks: Laura + Jonas for comp/role definitions
- QBR outlines: Markus + Marissa (we'll draft the executive risk slide)

Two clarifying items:
1) For headcount delta, do you want net hires by org or hires vs. backfills? I recommend net new FTEs to keep comparisons simple.
2) Please include CS as an explicit owner list for the QBR deck; they should own renewal-risk slides.

Also — timeline is tight for 11/12 staffing asks. If teams need more time, propose pushing that by 3 business days rather than compromising scenario quality.

On Wed's sync I'll bring a short template for headcount lines.

Couple of perspective notes from strategy:

- Recommend a 10% reserve buffer in the base scenario for unforeseen ramp slippage. That should be modeled as an optional pool rather than committed headcount.
- Upside should be expressed as both revenue and runway impact (i.e., hiring cadence vs. cash burn).
- If we plan to voice rate-limit (reduce batch sizes or opt for quantization) as a cost-control in downside, we should include projected SLA deltas so product & ops can sign off.

Stephanie — can you run a quick ops sensitivity on infra spend vs 1k/5k/10k QPS to inform the downside model?

I can take the QBR executive risk slide and draft one recommended narrative (pointers + 1 pager).

-Markus

- Scenario templates: Laura + Mina to deliver base/downside/upside tables (due 11/10) (Laura, Mina)
- Staffing asks: Laura + Jonas to collate org-level asks; please indicate net hires vs backfills (due 11/15; shifted 3 days) (Laura, Jonas)
- QBR executive risk slide: Markus to draft narrative + Marissa to finalize deck outline (due 11/17) (Markus, Marissa)
- Ops sensitivity: Stephanie to run infra spend vs QPS buckets for downside model (due 11/11) (Stephanie)

I've attached the updated template and dropped a working copy in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3AnnualPlanning (Annual planning folder).

Alex (HavenCloud) — looping you in so you have visibility to timeline for any partner quotes; we may need a two-week turnaround on commercial pricing if the upside scenario triggers capacity commitments.

If there are no major blockers, I'll share a one-pager for execs on Monday 11/09 that summarizes the three scenarios + recommended staffing signal.

Attachments: qbr-deck-outline.pptx (slides); headcount-scenarios.csv (csv)
